items.title: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
items.summary: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves.

items.title: Morpho Blames AI Marketing Tool for Deleted Post Saying Its Own Curator Business Model is Broken
items.summary: The post from Morpho's official X account said most curator businesses are not self-sustaining from vault fees and that the business lives in private distribution agreements.

items.title: Kalshi loses appeal over Ohio and Tennessee sports betting laws, widening circuit split
items.summary: A federal appeals court ruled on Friday that Kalshi has not adequately shown its sports event contracts are swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act.

items.title: Kraken’s parent Payward is betting billions on becoming financial infrastructure, not just a crypto exchange
items.summary: Kraken parent Payward is unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services on common rails, co-CEO Arjun Sethi said.
